parole.testo: Borrowed from Medieval Latin sclavus (“slave”), from Late Latin Sclavus (“Slav”), from Byzantine Greek Σκλάβος (Sklábos), which see for more. Doublet of slav and șcheau.

Inherited from Late Latin sclavus or Sclavus, from Byzantine Greek Σκλάβος (Sklábos, “Slav”); see there for more. Compare Aromanian shcljau, Albanian shqa.
